views.markdown: Enable Apple’s native Always-On Display on unsupported devices! (iOS 16.0+)
Includes the native AOD panel with wallpaper and notification options. Always-On StandBy should work too on iOS 17.0+.

Warning: this tweak will impact battery life, especially on non-ProMotion displays. Recommended only for iPhone 13 Pro for now (can theoretically drop to 10Hz). Low Power Mode temporarily disables AOD (this is native behavior).
Tested on iPhone 13 Pro on iOS 17.0. iOS 16, 18 and 26 are untested. YMMV.
